data.desc: Elong Power Holding Limited is an exempted company incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands. Adhering to its development strategy of 'Asset-Light, R&D-Intensive, AI + Energy Storage, Global Scenario Deployment', the Company focuses on its core lithium battery energy storage system business. As a global provider of intelligent energy storage system solutions, it delivers energy storage products featuring high-reliability, enhanced safety and superior cost competitiveness, covering portable energy storage, residential energy storage, commercial and industrial (C&I) energy storage and utility-scale energy storage.
